reason: The police finding my son two streets away is exactly why I care about this, but I am not putting a camera on him, even one that stays off until an SOS. He would feel watched and I would have to explain it to him, and that is a dignity problem I do not want to solve with a camera.
objection: A camera on my child's body, and a log that shows who viewed the video. Consent and dignity matter more to me than the feature list, and I cannot be sure he would ever agree to wear it.
would_change_my_mind: A GPS-and-SOS version with no camera at all, or a camera that only the family can switch on with the wearer told in advance how it works, at a price that beats an AirTag plus a watch.
